A helium balloon is taped to a top-pan balance. A metal block of mass 100g is placed on the
balance. The reading on the balance is 91g.
helium balloon
metal block
Which statement can be deduced from this experiment?
A
The balloon exerts a downward force of 0.09N on the top-pan balance.
B
The helium has a mass of –9g.
C
The helium has a mass of +9g.
D
The resultant downward force on the top-pan balance is 0.89N.

options.label: A
options.text: The balloon exerts a downward force of 0.09N on the top-pan balance.

options.label: B
options.text: The helium has a mass of –9g.
